name: Priya
text: Came out at 9pm on a Sunday, fixed the burst pipe in 40 minutes. The price was the one they quoted on the phone.

name: Dave
text: Blocked drain had us stuck for two days. Cleared in an hour, and he showed us the camera footage so we knew what caused it.

name: Sophie
text: Hot water died on a freezing Tuesday. New unit installed by the afternoon, and they took the old one away.

name: Michael
text: Plumbing for our bathroom reno was done on the day they said. Tidy, quiet and no surprises on the invoice.

name: Jenny
text: Smelt gas at 6am and rang the emergency line. A real person answered, and a plumber was here in 35 minutes.

name: Tom
text: Two taps and a leaking toilet valve fixed in one visit. Fair price, and he wiped down the vanity before he left.
